payload.title: MP-CGA-005: Agent — LLM retry policy and structured error taxonomy
payload.body:
**ID:** MP-CGA-005 | **Priority:** P0 | **PRD refs:** FR1, FR4 | **Status:** draft
**Group:** MP Content Generation Agent (`mp-content-generation-agent`)

---

# Agent — LLM retry policy and structured error taxonomy

## Summary

The agent currently makes a single OpenAI call with no retry logic; any failure propagates as a thrown error and results in an HTTP 500. This ticket implements a bounded retry loop using the `llmRetry` config group, classifies OpenAI errors into retryable and non-retryable categories, and introduces the full error taxonomy (outcome codes) used by subsequent diagnostic and skip-if-fresh tickets.

## Scope

- In scope:
  - Implement a `retryWithBackoff` utility (e.g. `src/lib/retry.ts`) that accepts `maxAttempts`, `baseDelayMs`, `maxDelayMs`, `jitter` from the `llmRetry` config group and retries a given async function (like `generateObject`) on retryable errors.
  - Classify Vercel AI SDK errors into **retryable** (e.g. `AIServerError`, `APICallError` with rate limit or 5xx, request timeout) and **non-retryable** (`TypeValidationError`, auth `401`, bad request `400`, context length exceeded, content policy violation, etc.). Document the classification table in a code comment.
  - Replace the single `openai.chat.completions.create(...)` call in `generateContentWithOpenAI` (or equivalent) with the retry-wrapped `generateObject` from the `ai` package (using `@ai-sdk/openai`).
  - Apply the `timeoutMs` config value as the per-request `generateObject` timeout flag or AbortSignal.
  - Define and export a canonical error taxonomy type/enum covering all outcome codes the PRD requires:
    - `no_sources` (used by skip path — precheck stage)
    - `skipped_fresh_newsletter_exists` (used by skip-if-fresh — MP-CGA-006)
    - `openai_retry_exhausted` (LLM retries exhausted)
    - `openai_non_retryable` (non-retryable LLM error)
    - `openai_invalid_response` (LLM returned unexpected shape)
    - `validation_failed` (Zod parse of LLM output failed)
    - `persist_transient` (transient agent-data-api error on newsletter create)
    - `persist_client_error` (non-retryable agent-data-api error on newsletter create)
  - Map existing "no sources" path to `no_sources` taxonomy code and return a **skipped** outcome instead of a failed one (aligning with the PRD target; note: today this returns `success: false` with a message — update to a consistent internal outcome type that MP-CGA-007 will use to write the diagnostic).
  - Unit tests: retry attempts exhausted, non-retryable error stops immediately, jitter produces values within expected range, `no_sources` maps to skipped outcome.
- Out of scope:
  - Persist retry (MP-CGA-009).
  - Writing diagnostic records (MP-CGA-007).
  - Skip-if-fresh check (MP-CGA-006).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `retryWithBackoff` retries up to `llmRetry.maxAttempts` times on retryable errors, with exponential backoff bounded by `baseDelayMs` and `maxDelayMs`, and optional jitter.
- [ ] A retryable error (e.g. simulated `429`) results in exactly `maxAttempts` attempts before throwing `openai_retry_exhausted`.
- [ ] A non-retryable error (e.g. simulated `401`) results in exactly 1 attempt; `openai_non_retryable` is thrown immediately.
- [ ] `timeoutMs` is passed as the per-request timeout to the OpenAI SDK call; a timeout error is treated as retryable.
- [ ] The error taxonomy type/enum is defined and exported from a shared location (e.g. `src/types/outcome.ts`) — all outcome codes in the PRD's FR4 list are present.
- [ ] The "no sources" path returns an internal outcome with code `no_sources` and a `skipped` flag; it does not call OpenAI.
- [ ] The agent's final `AgentRunResult` for a skipped outcome returns `{ success: false, message: "..." }` (consistent with current `@workspace/agent-runtime` envelope — the `skipped` distinction is expressed in the diagnostic record once MP-CGA-007 lands; no envelope change required in this ticket).
- [ ] Unit tests (following `vitest-unit-testing` skill): all retry scenarios, non-retryable short-circuit, no_sources skipped outcome, jitter bounds.
- [ ] `pnpm code-quality` passes with no new errors.

## Dependencies

- Depends on: MP-CGA-003 (config schema must include `llmRetry` and `openai.timeoutMs`)
- Blocks: MP-CGA-006 (skip-if-fresh reuses the outcome type), MP-CGA-007 (writes diagnostic using outcome codes)

## Stacked delivery

This ticket changes agent error handling behavior but does not affect the happy path. Callers (Hermes pipeline) receive the same HTTP envelope shape — `{ success: false }` for failures. The internal outcome type introduced here is consumed by MP-CGA-007 (diagnostics writing), which is a dependent ticket.

**Merge order:** Ship after MP-CGA-003. Can be developed in parallel with MP-CGA-004; branch from MP-CGA-003's branch or from `main` after MP-CGA-003 merges. MP-CGA-006 should stack on top of this ticket.

## Notes

- Extract the retry utility (`src/lib/retry.ts`) as a pure function that takes the action as a callback and an `isRetryable` classifier. This makes it independently testable with `vi.useFakeTimers()` per the `vitest-unit-testing` skill.
- Use `vi.useFakeTimers()` + `vi.useRealTimers()` in `afterEach` for retry delay tests to avoid actual sleep in the test suite.
- The Vercel AI SDK exposes typed error classes (e.g. `AIServerError`, `TypeValidationError`, `APICallError`); use these typed error classes for the retryable/non-retryable classification rather than duck-typing status codes where possible.
- `validation_failed` covers the case where the LLM returns HTTP 200 but the response body fails `generateObject`'s built-in Zod validation (throws `TypeValidationError`); this is not a retryable error per the PRD.
- The canonical outcome type defined here (e.g. a union type `OutcomeCode` and a result object `AgentOutcome`) will be used across MP-CGA-006, MP-CGA-007, and MP-CGA-008 — design it for extensibility from the start.

PRD: https://github.com/hyperjumptech/mediapulse/blob/prds/content-generation-agent-prd.md
